input: Research private school options for next fall

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The student's age and grade level determines which schools are even eligible, and shapes every other filter applied during research.
Knowing whether this is a first-pass list of schools or a deep evaluation of finalists determines how broad vs. deep the research should be.
Geographic location or willingness to consider boarding schools defines the pool of schools that are physically viable options.
Tuition range is a hard filter — schools outside the budget can be eliminated immediately, saving significant research time.
Specific priorities such as academics, arts, sports, religious affiliation, or school size determine how schools are ranked and compared.
Application deadlines for the coming fall may already be approaching, which affects how urgently the research needs to move and whether some schools are already closed to applicants.
Knowing what a good outcome looks like — a shortlist, a comparison document, scheduled tours — defines when the research task is actually complete.

gold.taskTitle: Research private school options for next fall
gold.taskDescription: Identify and evaluate suitable private school options for a student enrolling in the upcoming fall semester.

questions.title: What grade will the student be entering next fall?
questions.description: Identify the student's grade level to determine which schools and programs are eligible.

questions.title: Are you researching day schools, boarding schools, or both?
questions.description: Clarify the type of school being considered to define the scope of research.

questions.title: What city or region should the schools be located in?
questions.description: Establish the geographic boundaries to filter schools by location.

questions.title: What is the maximum annual tuition you are comfortable with?
questions.description: Set a budget ceiling to immediately eliminate schools outside the financial range.

questions.title: What qualities matter most — academics, arts, sports, values?
questions.description: Identify the top priorities to use as ranking and comparison criteria across schools.

questions.title: How soon do the application deadlines fall for next fall entry?
questions.description: Determine urgency by checking whether application windows are already open or closing soon.

questions.title: What does a completed research task look like to you?
questions.description: Define the end deliverable — such as a shortlist, comparison chart, or scheduled school visits — so the task has a clear finish line.
